description:
This is a pre-solicitation notice, a solicitation will be posted at a late date.  The requirement is for (1) one Starrett brandname AVR300 optical coordinate measuring machine, with a workstation and one day of on-site training for the Product Test Center in Columbus, Ohio.

Please see the attached Performance Work Statement for the full details.

Interested parties do not need to submit a quote at this time, but are encouraged to acknowledge their interest to the POC listed within this pre-solicitation notification.
